Documents (Scaned Documents like PDF, JPG, PNG File Formats) This includes signed progress notes, available lab results, radiology reports, and any other scanned or uploaded document in the patient's record. Organizational Structure : All these documents are sorted and indexed within the respective patient chart number folders. If there are specific categories or types for these documents (e.g., Lab Reports, Radiology, Scanned Receipts, etc.), they will reside in their respective category subfolder within the primary patient folder.
